v2.0.0.note: The toolbox. Four fetchable answers at MV1-2 for no measured cost, on the enchantment-creature list that replaced commander damage. MAJOR: the strategy changed — this deck no longer wins by connecting with Zur.

v2.1.0.note: The drain engine, assembled. Manabase fixed (black on curve 0.667 -> 0.785), real ramp including Urza's Saga fetched by the commander, one-sided graveyard hate, and two Shrines that drain and gain into three lifegain payoffs. MINOR: the deck does something new — a drain clock that scales — without changing what it is.

v2.2.0.note: The constellation engine. Zur's fetch trigger now feeds two drains, a lifegain into three payoffs, a card draw and three token engines. kill-by-t8 0.351 -> 0.514, board power at ten 18.73 -> 28.04. MINOR: the deck does something new without changing what it is.

v2.3.0.note: Master of Keys out, Fear of Infinity in. MINOR because the deck gains something it did not have: another Eerie payoff reading the commander's own trigger, a lifelink body feeding the three drain payoffs, and a threat that returns itself. The card leaving was a 3-mana 3/3 flier whose entire text box was inert in this list.

v2.3.1.note: Mana only: four lands whose coloured mode costs extra mana replaced by untapped duals and a Swamp. On-curve FLOOR up on every colour (W +0.035, U +0.044, B +0.079), gated lands 6 -> 2. PATCH by the version rule — the mana changed and nothing else did.

v2.3.2.note: Mana only: The Grey Havens out, Shattered Sanctum in. It made coloured mana only from legendary creature cards in a graveyard this deck cannot fill. Real sources W +1 / B +1, gated lands 3 -> 2, on-curve floor W +0.017 and B +0.024. PATCH — the mana changed and nothing else did.

v2.4.0.note: The Shrine engine. Six Shrines, each an enchantment entering that nine cards already read, and three of them reading it back. Board power at ten 22.08 -> 26.65, drain 12.63 -> 15.47, kill-by-t7 +0.010 excluding zero. Master of the Feast out: it fed three opponents a card every upkeep. MINOR — the deck does something new, a Shrine count that scales three separate effects, without changing what it is.

v3.0.0.note: A NEW COMMANDER. Zur, Eternal Schemer replaces Zur the Enchanter, whose search Forge resolved 1.1 times a game — a rate at which the deck measured identically to having no trigger at all. The new commander needs no combat: every enchantment creature gains deathtouch, lifelink and hexproof, and {1}{W} turns any non-Aura enchantment into a body whose power is its mana value. MAJOR by the version rule, on both counts — the commander changed and so did the strategy. NO FORGE RUN EXISTS for this list.
